findings.summary: LIVE-VS-SIMS DIVERGENCE — the good bot loses on the live rig but wins in the deterministic sims: sims show good=won at t=77.0 (capillaries@0.1 → artery@22.1 → boss@46.1 → won@77.0) and partial=won at t=69.0 with 2 fumbles (clumsy fails proven at t=35.2 with 'L'infection prend le dessus'), yet the live run's good bot died at t≈51 s in the boss phase under the HUD 'PURGE FINALE — CYCLE 1/3' with the 'TRY AGAIN / L'infection prend le dessus' overlay and ♥ ×2 remaining (bank spend visible) — suspects, record-only and NOT fixed here: real-timing input cadence, AudioContext unlock path, or boss-phase input handling in the genre module (boss machinery at nano-cure.js:336-348); note the refreshed live-run evidence dir retains only still-boot.png, so the live death is trace-observed rather than still-captured.

Boss-phase copy is French-only while the booth is EN-first: the HUD mid string flips to 'PURGE FINALE — CYCLE n/3' / 'PURGE FINALE — NETTOYAGE' (nano-cure.js:631), the phase banner reads 'PURGE FINALE / Absorbez les spores pour ouvrir la membrane' (:225) and 'MEMBRANE OUVERTE / Tirez le noyau !' (:340), and the fail line is 'L'infection prend le dessus — retente ta chance !' (:326) — all FR-only, even though the level's own objective copy is English ('Cleanse the bloodstream…', level.json), so EN signage breaks exactly at the finale where the live run died.
